name: io.github.selectarank/selectarank-mcp
description: Pay-per-call rates (US/JP), ECB FX, SEC filings, USGS, NOAA, World Bank and x402 preflight via USDC on Base.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Private key of a Base wallet holding USDC. If unset, tools return the 402 payment requirements instead of paying.

environmentVariables.name: SELECTARANK_MAX_PRICE_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Refuse to auto-pay more than this many USDC per call (default 0.05).
